medium.note: The lived rhythm. Damped about 0.83, so amplitude times damping times `lib/sensitivity.py`'s slope, some thirty times Earth's solar-cycle signal and the dominant climatic fact of any individual life. Fast enough to be planned around, too fast for ice to follow. The kelvin figure is NOT restated here: it is a product of a slope that is re-derived per model, and the two numbers that stood here before reproduced at a slope retired two measurements ago.

long.note: The geomorphic driver. Essentially undamped at 0.99, so amplitude times damping times the same slope, slow enough that glaciers equilibrate rather than merely breathing. Each grand minimum is a distinct historical era.

executable.note: Built precision is not encoded in the filename. The registry's naming carries no precision at all, which is why `arm` below is the only statement of an arm's.

surface_fields.note: Fields absent from the run directory are preset to uniform namelist values by landmod and never read from file.

asymptotic_mixing_length_m.units: metres; fluxini's 160*(OMEGA_EARTH/ww) from Blackadar (1962) eq. 25 when the namelist gave a sentinel, the declared length otherwise

cloud_fraction_subgrid_width.units: dimensionless; rainini's (RCNLATREF/NLAT)^(1/3) when the namelist gave a sentinel, the declared factor otherwise

precip_reevaporation_fall_speed_coeffici.units: m/s; rainini's 5.17*sqrt(ga/9.80665), the drop fall-speed coefficient the derived per-cell gamma turns on and the whole of what this world's gravity changes in it. Under a declared constant gamma the model prints that constant instead and `branch` says so

energy_fixer_applied.note: the energy the fixer had to restore; a CORRECTION and not physics. It is the size of the defect on world-0ov, which the fixer otherwise hides. Second half of the run only.
